title: Does it need that permission?
instruction: Apps want these permissions. When does it make sense, and when is it suspicious?

items.why: Without your location they can’t navigate you.
It doesn’t need contacts to shine.

items.text: A video calling app wants the camera and microphone
items.why: A call doesn’t work without them.

items.text: A calculator wants to read your text messages
items.why: A malware classic: verification codes arrive by text message.

items.text: A QR code scanner wants the camera
items.why: It has to see the QR code.

items.text: A wallpaper app wants your location even when you aren’t using it
items.why: A wallpaper doesn’t need to track you.

items.text: A game wants access to all your files
items.why: Playing doesn’t need your documents and photos.

debrief: A permission should fit what the app does. When it doesn’t fit, the app is most likely collecting data, or it is malware.
